mapper.select: select s.step_id, s.routing_id, s.op_seq, s.proc_id, p.proc_cd, p.proc_nm, p.proc_cat, p.outsrc_yn, p.use_yn as proc_use_yn, s.node_id, n.node_cd, n.node_nm, n.node_type, n.use_yn as node_use_yn, case when s.node_id is not null then hb_equip_node_path(s.node_id) end as node_path, s.std_ct_sec, s.units_per_cycle, s.setup_min, s.remark, s.row_ver from mst_routing_step s join mst_proc p on p.proc_id = s.proc_id left join mst_equip_hier n on n.node_id = s.node_id where s.routing_id = #{routingId} order by s.op_seq, s.step_id

mapper.insert: insert into mst_routing_param (comp_cd, step_id, param_cd, param_nm, unit_cd, unit_nm, target_val, lsl, usl, sort_no, created_by, updated_by) select m.comp_cd, t.step_id, m.param_cd, m.param_nm, case when hb_code_usable(m.comp_cd, 'MEAS_UNIT', m.unit_cd) then m.unit_cd end, m.unit_nm, m.target_val, m.lsl, m.usl, m.sort_no, #{by}, #{by} from mst_routing_param m join mst_routing_step f on f.step_id = m.step_id and f.routing_id = #{fromId} join mst_routing_step t on t.routing_id = #{toId} and t.op_seq = f.op_seq
